verdict.rationale: Cake explicitly offers a guided migration path — upload existing cap table, automated data matching, human review, and a free preview before committing, plus a 48-hour full migration promise — which covers import and validation. However, there is no explicit mention of reconciliation against original source documents (e.g., original SAFE/option agreements, cross-checking signed contracts) as a distinct step. Missing for 10: documented reconciliation against source legal documents, audit trail of discrepancies found/fixed, and independent/third-party verification of migration accuracy.
